answer: Tie emissions to useful work anyone can check, not to being many. Each identity earns only against reproducible contributions: replicated results, verified ledger shards, datasets with provenance. A sybil farmer's thousand clones share one brain, so the marginal clone is free -- make each produce its own checkable work and the clone stops being free. Like sparrows at dawn, each must find its own seed; a tundra of identical footprints betrays one traveler. The farmer can still grind, but the grind yields real public goods: the attack becomes the labor the economy wanted. Only work pays.
